def accepted(cap: int, xs: list[int]) -> int uses nondet:
    """Create an integer channel with capacity cap and try to send each element of xs without blocking. Return how many sends were accepted before the channel was full, then stop."""
    pre cap >= 0
    post out >= 0 and out <= cap and out <= xs.len()
    tx, rx = Channel[int](cap)
    n = 0
    for x in xs:
        if not tx.try_send(x):
            break
        n += 1
    return n
